title: Cleared in 2022
sentences: The last Salem ‘witch’ wasn’t officially cleared until 2022.
Elizabeth Johnson Junior was convicted in 1693 and sentenced to death, but she was spared.
Massachusetts cleared many of the condemned in 1711, and more in 1957 and 2001.
Her name was left out every time.
Then an eighth-grade civics class in North Andover took up her case.
In July 2022, the governor signed her exoneration, 329 years after her conviction.
caption:
The last Salem 'witch' wasn't officially cleared until 2022, thanks to a class of eighth graders.
